banner: S-16001  -  a vendor part WAS received on this branch, then 1 of 3 returned   (build v3.8-1f5fb3c)
caption:
CORRECTION to my earlier note: receiving a part is NOT broken. It is done from the Receive button on the part row,
which calls POST /api/orders/receive-requested-parts and returns 200. The /accept-delivery screen I used before is a
different, dead path. This part reached Received, the work order was invoiced, then 1 of 3 was returned.

banner: S-15999  -  issued invoice AFTER returning 1 of 3 parts   -   rounding mode: Invoice total
caption:
The issued invoice document for S-15999, read AFTER the part return. Subtotal $244.00, tax $23.79, total $267.79 -
exactly what it was billed. This is the "Invoice total" invoice; the other mode gives the identical result, so a part
return does not rewrite an issued invoice under either rounding method (AC6).

caption:
Observation, NOT caused by this ticket. On the invoiced work order S-15999 the panel now shows Subtotal $164.00
with the tax line still at $23.79, so its Total reads $187.79 - not the invoiced $267.79 (which the Balance still
shows correctly) and not a clean recompute of $179.99. Identical on "Invoice total" and on the other mode, figure for
figure, so the rounding change is not what causes it.
